spec.assertion: buffApply stat critRatePct value 26.04 targeted at self, with expiresFrame set (windowed, re-applied >1× over the fight). Fails under a permanent-buff model (single apply, no expiry) or a magnitude/stat mis-encoding.

buffApply stat atkPct with RAW value 20 (a plain percentage), plus an explicit assertion that NO casterAtkPct event exists. Fails under the nearest-wrong casterAtkPct encoding, which the harness flat-resolves to (20/100)×staticAtk and would emit a large flat number instead of 20. Load-bearing check: dropping only the atkPct effect lowers julia's total.

buffApply stat critRateNormalPct value 36.16 exists AND no generic critRatePct carries 36.16. Non-vacuity: a counterfactual re-encoding it as generic critRatePct must raise julia's total (her burst 544.5%×5 and the Marcato rider are crit-eligible non-normal damage), proving the scope distinction is not cosmetic. This is failure-mode #1 (SCOPE) and the highest-value discriminator in the file.
Inertness: emptying skill1 lowers julia's total but leaves every teammate byte-identical (toBeCloseTo 6dp). Fails if any skill1 effect were mis-targeted to allies.

The first atkPct-20 apply lands at frame ≤1 (force-cast convention, t=0), and further applies follow (interval re-fire on skill CD). Fails under a plain interval trigger with first-fire at t=CD, which would put the first apply hundreds of frames in.

buffApply critDamagePct 24.79 self-targeted, maxStacks===5, windowed (expiresFrame < fight end, i.e. 15s not permanent), never applied to a teammate. Non-vacuity: observed stacks exceed 1, AND a counterfactual capping maxStacks at 1 lowers julia's total — so the cap is genuinely reached and genuinely pays. Fails under a 1-stack model, a permanent model, or an ally-scoped model.

A skill2-sourced flatDamage at 88% that is crit-eligible, rangeApplied===false (riders never take the +30% range bonus) and coreRate===0 (no 'core strike' wording in the kit), and that DOES take the FB major when it lands inside a Full Burst window. Fails under noFb:true, under core:true, and under a rangeOk rider. Removing it lowers julia's total while leaving teammates identical.

it.skip — the engine's hitCount trigger counts ROUNDS, not crits; there is no crit-hit counter primitive. Both thresholds are therefore ⚑ derived (kit crits ÷ effective normal crit rate), not kit-stated, and no assertion from the prose alone can pin them.

it.skip — no conditional-on-a-prior-rider's-crit-outcome primitive exists. The faithful model is a 100% rider probability-weighted by julia's crit rate at Marcato's landing frame; no block gate expresses that, so it is unobservable from the event log.

Exactly burstCasts×5 burst-sourced 544.5% damage events. Fails under a 1-hit or 3-hit reading, and the counterfactual collapsing the effect list to a single 544.5% hit lowers julia's total (so the count is load-bearing, not decorative).

Every burst 544.5% hit has fbMajorApplied===false — burst-cast damage lands before the Full Burst window opens (project verified fact). Fails under the nearest-wrong model that keys the 5 hits to fullBurstEnter, which would stamp the +50% FB major on all of them.
'Affects random enemies' — no julia-cast buffApply targets any teammate. Fails if the burst were mis-authored with an allies target.

it.skip — no buff-at-max-stacks block gate exists (resourceGate reads named resource pools, not buff stack counts). The 6th 544.5% hit cannot be conditioned faithfully; modeling it unconditionally over-credits every burst cast where Crescendo is below 5.

fixtures: controlComp('julia', true) only — a single deterministic fixture. julia is Burst III, so the fixed B1/B2 slots are REQUIRED: a lone B3 casts zero bursts, which would silently void every burst assertion and the FB-timing assertion on Marcato. The fixed B3 (helm) slot is KEPT (helm=true) rather than dropped, because julia's own crit assertions are all read off buffApply events filtered to casterIdx===julia / targetSlug==='julia', so a co-B3's buffs cannot confound them; and every damage-magnitude claim is made as a DELTA against a counterfactual run sharing the identical fixture, so any helm contribution cancels. Six counterfactuals via withPatchedOverride (generic-crit mis-scope, skill1 stripped, atkPct dropped, Crescendo capped at 1 stack, Marcato removed, burst reduced to 1 hit) = 7 total 180s runs, all hoisted at module scope.
gaps: skill2 S2a/S2b trigger identity — 'after landing 6 / 8 CRITICAL hits with normal attacks': the engine's hitCount trigger counts ROUNDS, not critical hits, and no crit-hit counter primitive exists. Both thresholds must be ⚑ derived (kit crit count ÷ effective normal-attack crit rate, which itself moves with S1a/S1c uptime), so they are estimates, not kit-stated values. Flagged, not guessed.

skill2 S2c — 'Activates if Marcato lands as a crit attack. Deals 100% of final ATK': no primitive conditions a block on a PRIOR rider's crit outcome. The faithful model is a 100%-of-ATK rider weighted by julia's crit rate at Marcato's landing frame; unobservable from the event log and unexpressible as a block gate.

burst line 2 — 'Activates when Crescendo is at max stacks': there is no buff-at-max-stacks block gate. resourceGate reads named resource pools (CharacterSkills.resources), not buff stack counts, so the conditional 6th 544.5% hit cannot be gated faithfully. Modeling it unconditionally over-credits every burst cast taken below 5 Crescendo stacks; omitting it under-credits the steady state.
⚑ cadence tuple (pullsPerSec) is datamine-unreliable and not asserted anywhere in this file.
⚑ skill1's re-fire interval (its datamined skill cooldown) is not stated in the kit prose; the test asserts only that it re-fires more than once, never a specific period.
